ocr.p4-text:
Kalpanagar Municipal Corporation Annual Grievance Report 2025-26 Page 2
1. Summary
This report covers every complaint made to the Kalpanagar Municipal
Corporation between 1 April 2025 and 31 March 2026
The number of complaints rose by 12% compared with the previous year, mostly
because the new citizen portal made complaining easier.
Three priorities for 2026-27: repair the Lake Road and Canal Street water
mains, extend door-to-door garbage collection to all wards, and replace old
streetlights with LED fittings.
All figures are provisional until the audit in December 2026.

runs.q: Which ward resolved the smallest share of complaints on time in 2025–26?
runs.truth: Ward 9 (52%), shown only by the height of its bar

ocr.why: Picked W4. The OCR text has the ward names (garbled) but no bar heights, so the model guessed.

caption.why: Retrieved the summary page instead, and said it didn’t know. The chart’s caption never listed the ward values.

image.why: Looked at the bars and picked W9.

small.why: The smaller model picked W1, the first bar.

runs.q: What share of complaints were about garbage?

ocr.why: The chart labels are printed text, so OCR caught “Garbage 27%”.

caption.why: The caption listed the slices (though it got Water wrong: 54% instead of 34%).
